reference_facts.text: Switching the app language from English to Spanish makes the History tab show 'No workouts yet'
Switching the language back to English restores the history display
The web dashboard shows the workout data correctly, so no data is deleted
The issue reproduces on at least two devices (Pixel 8 phone and Galaxy Tab tablet)

output_facts.text: In the Meridian fitness app, workout history disappears after switching the app language from English to Spanish
After the language change, the History tab shows "No workouts yet" despite months of existing workout data
The workout data is not deleted
Switching the app language back to English restores the workout history
The web dashboard shows the workout data correctly throughout
The affected app is the Meridian fitness app on mobile
The issue was reproduced on a Pixel 8 phone
The issue was reproduced on a Galaxy Tab tablet
The affected account is a Premium account
The issue is reproducible every time
The issue is a display/retrieval issue only, since the underlying data is intact
